features.title: History route: five landmarks, one question each, a result

features.title: History routes, round 3: task types that use the 3D map
features.user_visible_behavior: Each stop of a history route sets one task, by type: multiple choice, true/false (two buttons, then whether the statement is true and the quote that settles it), sequence (three or four events moved up and down by keyboard or touch, «Check the order», then each event's dated quote), visual detail (a question about what the 3D model shows, with «Show the place»), and find on the map (the camera pulls back over several landmarks shown as «?» markers; a click or tap on the right model, pin or marker solves it; a wrong one names the place picked; after two wrong picks the place's marker stands out; the card lists the same places as buttons). Every type: retry with no penalty, gold first time, plain after a retry, the quote and sources after success. Both routes mix the types; text pages show no tasks. quest_step_completed carries the task type.
